fault_model: one sequential-state bit upset in one controller replica or one guard sticky-state bit; no simultaneous common-mode, clock, reset, input-wire or combinational faults
isolation: independent retained replicas; synthesis/mapping must prove no shared state roots

routing.placement: two full controller leaves with output faces toward central guard; mirror right leaf

replica_mux_cost: 43 equality XOR/XNOR bits and balanced reduction; gates all emitted fields, valid, write enable and returned credits; two separately retained sticky-halt bits
replica_fanout_cost: incoming command/read-credit fanout2; clock and reset distribution must qualify actual three-region context

latency.output_logic_depth: 43bit equality balanced tree plus fail-closed field gates; actual SS/FF gate delay unmeasured
latency.command_data_alignment: no stage added to any JEDEC command; external write-data alignment unchanged in fault-free operation
latency.credit_reservation: unchanged eight ingress credits and same-cycle return; no delayed credit added; after fault no new credits emitted
latency.refresh: no added command cycle, so first and later refresh timestamps equal pinned controller; baseline DRAM startup epoch and parent fault-refresh handoff still require binding

adoption_blocks: parent fault abort and already-issued write drain
physical_phy_scope: same row_v/col_v accepted-command contract as ot_qwen_hbm_stream_ack; no pin-level CA encoder claim
